  "explanation": "GHSA-gx76-c99x-2c96 (CVE-2026-111749) covers a subdomain removing the Host-Only scope from an existing cookie. It affects aiohttp before 3.14.4, and NVD also says it is fixed in 3.14.4."
}

{
  "abstain": false,
  "verdict": null,
  "ids": ["GHSA-2fqr-mr3j-6wp8"],
  "value": null,
  "disagreement": {"flagged": false, "values": {"github": null, "nvd": null}},
  "explanation": "GHSA-2fqr-mr3j-6wp8 (CVE-2026-54279) describes host-only cookies losing their host-only status after CookieJar.save() and CookieJar.load(), so they may be sent to subdomains. It is fixed in aiohttp 3.14.1."
}

  "explanation": "minimist 1.2.3 falls in the affected range of GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h (1.0.0 before 1.2.6, alias CVE-2021-44906). It is not affected by GHSA-vh95-rmgr-6w4m, whose range ends before 1.2.3."
}
